assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are repository provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Every area-dependent drawing and metric must be regenerated when official EPSG/geometry is released.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, building density, setbacks, road redlines, heritage-control lines, ownership and utility constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control, demolition decision or construction commitment is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Existing building, mobility, footfall, accessibility, ecology and heat baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Pilot gates require a measured baseline before intervention; current node locations are directional.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, procurement routes and maintenance responsibilities are proposed as role classes only.
assumptions.impact: Named public arrangements require later authorization and agreements.

assumptions.statement: AI services are advisory and must preserve offline/manual equivalents.
assumptions.impact: No biometric identification, automated enforcement or irreversible decision is included.
